requirements.text: Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field of study and five (5) years of progressive post-baccalaureate experience in the job offered or related occupation. Alternatively, a Master’s degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field of study and three (3) years of experience in the job offered or related occupation.
Experience must include two (2) years involving each of the following:
Developing graph-based ML models such as GraphSAGE, GAT, or Graph Transformers;
Experience must include two (2) years involving each of the following:
Experience fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) as part of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines; and
Experience must include two (2) years involving each of the following:
Legacy supervised learning models, including development and deployment using methods like XGBoost; and
